run_model_free_ptq_w8a8: run model_free_ptq to apply W8A8 quantization to a Qwen3.5 model and save the quantized weights
run_model_free_ptq_ignore_layers: run model_free_ptq with an ignore list to skip lm_head, norm, embed_tokens, and other specified layers from quantization
run_model_free_ptq_multiworker: run model_free_ptq with max_workers=15 on cuda:0 to quantize a model using parallel workers
run_model_free_ptq_custom_scheme: run model_free_ptq with a custom quantization scheme and save_directory for the compressed-tensors output
run_model_free_ptq_regex_ignore: run model_free_ptq with regex patterns in the ignore list to exclude mlp.gate, visual, and conv1d layers
